_comment: Reference model for the B-side physics baseline (component 0 of graph.json). Same reference time, objective, weights and conventions as physics_config.json. Node names are electrical nodes as Caltech's topology code builds them. The injection map mirrors Caltech's A-side map by structural analogy: the main feed line at the top node (line_383, egauge_20, meter bus on the source side behind main breaker cb_122) with sign +1, and each building's own breaker (transformer side to load side) at its 277 V node with sign -1. These signs are ESTIMATED from the analogy and are to be tested on training-only quiet weeks (64 combinations, two periods, acceptance margin fixed before running); they are not documented by Caltech. Excluded as unresolved: line_384 (egauge_18), line_402 (egauge_16), line_429 (egauge_22); egauge_16 and egauge_22 still supply voltage terms. Zero-injection nodes are the nodes with no external injection in the reference circuit: the 1,386 V switchgear node fed by tr_118 through an edge of Y (the analog of the A-side switchgear node in Caltech's zero list), the eight 1,386 V intermediate nodes, and bus_1139, the tr_130 secondary whose only other element cb_151 is normally open with no status history and which carries no load or meter. They are zero-injection because of what sits on them, not because they make the matrix full rank; the rank check is a separate safeguard.
sign_status: estimated from the A-side analogy; sign test on training-only weeks not yet run
